title: Parameter exploration
subtitle: Predict, change a coefficient, and explain the graph.
instructions: Read the scientific question and predict how the output will change.
Change one control at a time and observe the interactive result.
Compare the result with your prediction and explain the evidence.
objectives: Explain how the coefficient changes a straight line's slope.
assumptions: This starter uses y = a × x with dimensionless variables and no intercept.

questions.question: What changes when the coefficient doubles?
questions.answer: For each fixed x, y doubles; the slope doubles.

questions.question: What does a negative coefficient do?
questions.answer: The line slopes downward: increasing positive x makes y more negative.

questions.question: Where do all these lines intersect?
questions.answer: At the origin, because this model has no intercept.
